values.expense.climateReports.aboutEmissionsSum:
**About emissions summary**
   
In this chart we're showing you this years amount of kilograms that are related to your expenses, mileages and travels.
    
The numbers are based on all of your approved claims.
    
We also show you the increase or decrease percentage compared to the same period last year.
    
Why do we show this? In some cases, your company might want to reduce its amount of emissions. Information like this might give valuable insight to help with this reduction.
    
**How do we calculate these emissions?**
    
Our emissions calculator uses a large database of emissions data from our partners to estimate your emissions by using the type and amount.
If you're interested you can read more about our partners by following these links.
values.expense.climateReports.emptyReportsPlace: Your emissions summary will appear here when a claim has been approved
values.expense.climateReports.limitationsDescri:
The emissions report represents a significant step towards promoting sustainability and eco-conscious decision-making. However, it's important to acknowledge that this feature does come with certain limitations.

We do not support calculating emissions for custom mileage types, snowmobiles or ATVs.

We do not calculate emissions for special allowances (e.g. compensation abroad), tax deductions (e.g. fuel benefits), or custom allowances.
